activityVerification.evidence: Camaradio's official site exposes live listening and recently played surfaces, a populated seven-day schedule, current 2026 station content, recurring community-event coverage and an event dated July 11, 2026. The site identifies the station as an FCC-licensed nonprofit 101.3 FM service streaming online and carries a 2026 copyright notice.

genreFitEvidence: Camaradio presents diverse music and community programming rather than a single narrow format.
The current schedule includes DJ Space Cat's Galactic Dance Party, Indie Beginnings, Deeper Grooves Rewind, rock, blues, jazz, vinyl and broad presenter-led music programmes.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, dance, reggae, world-fusion, indie-adjacent or cross-genre material has plausible fit after exact track and programme review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: Camaradio provides a legitimate free dedicated form, but the form contains a changing arithmetic CAPTCHA and a rights and broadcast authorization. A human must select one track, confirm international eligibility, rights, content and AI-origin policy, validate the exact downloadable link or compliant WAV/MP3 file, complete the CAPTCHA personally and submit manually.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search and the complete open pull-request patch were checked before creation for Camaradio, Camarillo Community Radio, camaradio.org, the canonical submissions path and hello@camaradio.org; no existing music-submission-agent platform, seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The dedicated submission form, its download-link and direct-upload alternatives, rights affirmation and arithmetic CAPTCHA are stored as one canonical Camaradio opportunity. The general contact form, sponsorship mailbox, station phone and text route, donations, newsletter, shop, social media and third-party contacts are excluded.

notes: One new Camaradio community-radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The authorized first-party route accepts one song through a permissioned download link or compliant WAV/MP3 upload and is protected by a human arithmetic challenge. No submission action was performed.
